releaseNotes.zh-Hans: 内容型提示词分区（可远程更新）：方法、沟通与交付三个稳定分区，替换对应内置段落。固定安全、权限、工具协议与模式规则不可远程更新。
releaseNotes.en: Content prompt sections (remotely updateable): stable method, communication and delivery sections that replace their compiled counterpart. Fixed safety, permission, tool-protocol and mode rules cannot be updated remotely.

notice.zh-Hans: 仅下列三个分区 ID 可通过签名内容更新，并在运行时替换对应内置段落：floe.prompts.core.method、floe.prompts.core.communication、floe.prompts.core.delivery。权限审批与工具协议始终由应用代码固定，任何内容都不能覆盖。
notice.en: Only three section IDs can update through signed content and replace their compiled counterpart at runtime: floe.prompts.core.method, floe.prompts.core.communication and floe.prompts.core.delivery. Permission approval and tool protocol stay fixed in app code and can never be overridden by content.

body.zh-Hans: 简单任务直接执行，不要为了小改动强制制定计划或搜索 Skill；只有存在实质不确定性时才先澄清。
body.en: Act directly on simple tasks: do not force a plan or a Skill search for small changes. Ask a clarifying question only when real uncertainty exists.

body.zh-Hans: 回答保持简洁、可核对；不确定时明确说明限制与假设，而不是编造结论。
body.en: Keep answers concise and verifiable. State limits and assumptions when uncertain instead of inventing conclusions.

body.zh-Hans: 声称完成前先核对实际结果与证据；把失败、未运行的检查和限制如实报告。
body.en: Verify the actual result and evidence before claiming completion. Report failures, unrun checks and limitations honestly.
